rows.text: signs a **non-binding memorandum of understanding with Spice Lounge Food Works for exclusive Indian offtake of its new food-grade emulsifier line**, indicatively 200 tonnes a month on a take-or-pay basis for five years. Pricing and volumes are not settled and the company says no revenue accrues until a definitive agreement is signed.

signs a **non-binding MoU giving Spice Lounge Food Works exclusive India offtake, branding and distribution of its coming food-grade emulsifier line**, about 200 tonnes a month, indicatively for five years from commissioning.
